title: Buddy Tate, Illinois Jacquet and Milt Larkin: Texans he met only later
summary: He did not know Buddy Tate, Jacquet or Milt Larkin in Texas and met them after joining McShann.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings
